title: <canvas-slot>
blurb: A custom element that slots its light-DOM children into a shadow canvas. They're drawn with effects and stay clickable, focusable and typeable.
question: Can a custom element with a canvas in its shadow root draw its light-DOM children and keep them clickable, focusable and typeable?

focusMoves.why: one check focuses an input in its fixture to prove typing reaches a slotted element; runTests() takes focus away again
